blurb: Wickford Boat Rentals offers a fleet of late model, fuel-efficient boats for full day, half day, hourly, and extended rentals. They provide captained charters for exploring Narragansett Bay and nearby destinations. Training and private lessons are available for those without prior boating experience.
extraNote: Overnight fees are 10% of discounted full day rate for lowest Captain's Club membership · Overnight fees waived for higher Captain's Club memberships · Downtown Wickford, RI, next to Chase Boats
